scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/doc-view typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/ui typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd packages/doc-view lint && bun run --cwd packages/ui lint
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/doc-view test && bun run --cwd packages/ui test
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/doc-view build && bun run --cwd packages/ui build
scripts.verify: bun run --cwd packages/doc-view verify && bun run --cwd packages/ui verify
scripts.test:consumer: bun run --cwd packages/doc-view test:consumer && bun run --cwd packages/ui test:consumer
scripts.format: bun run --cwd packages/doc-view format && bun run --cwd packages/ui format
scripts.release: bun run build && bun run verify && bun run check && bun run test:consumer && changeset publish
